text_block_list.text:
While carrying out training with Sweepy 
Tosho as usual—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
*Phew*~... Time for a little break! 
Familiar, fetch me some ice cream!

Somehow, Sweep Tosho's movements feel 
strangely sluggish. Could it be because of 
all the frequent snacking...?
choice_data_list:
If you eat sweets every break, you're 
gonna gain weight.

You'll gain weight if you have sweets 
every break, you know.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
How rude! There's no way I'd get fat, 
dummy! I'm a magical girl, you know!? 
Idiot!!

I came to the infirmary to check my weight 
just to be sure, but...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I-It hasn't gone up at all! It hasn't 
changed! I'm still perfect today, okay!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't want it! That's right, I'm in 
the mood for choc-mint today! I won't 
accept anything other than choc-mint!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, let's get back to 
training!

For a while after that, Sweep Tosho's 
unusually spirited training continued—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! Look at this, familiar! Behold 
these perfect stats!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
My weight control is always spot-on and 
perfect, you know!

—Whatever the case, Sweep Tosho's weight 
had returned to peak condition, much to my 
relief.
